harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: The clause «ما أغنى» is resumptive; «ما»: maṣdariyya (forming a verbal noun), and the maṣdar is conjoined to «ماله», i.e.: and his earning.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «وامرأته»: conjoined to the fāʿil (agent) in «يصلى», the conjunction being permitted by the separating element; «حمالة»: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the verb (أذم) (I censure), and the clause (أذم) is parenthetical between the ḥāl (circumstantial) and the one it describes.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: The clause «في جيدها حبل» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from «امرأته»; the preposition «مِنْ مسد» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «حبل».
